corpus: Microsoft Office native Computer Use fixtures

authoring.method: Computer Use / cua_repl native Microsoft Office UI on macOS
authoring.content: Synthetic fixture content entered into blank native documents; native Office formatting and feature commands; native Save As for legacy/binary variants.

validation.scope: Native authoring and saved structure/contents only. No claim that current library logic passes these fixtures.

format_notes.xls: Native Excel visual-analytics XLS reopened in Compatibility Mode after the accepted feature-loss warning; source table/filter/sort and PivotTable/PivotCache content were retained, while sparklines were absent after reopen and litchi-xls did not expose the native Sheet1 source worksheet in the generic probe. Native Excel conditional-drawings XLS reopened in Compatibility Mode after the accepted warning; BIFF8 conditional-formatting/CFEX, picture and rounded rectangle records are recorded. Its gradient positive-offset data bar differs from XLSX/XLSB solid negative-axis presentation; no parity or stopIfTrue toggle claim is made. Native Excel links/objects XLS reopened directly with Don’t Update after the compatibility warning; external cached values, classic note, Word preview and OLE package remain, while B5 converts to #VALUE!. Worksheet facade publishes zero sheets after suppressed parse error; no execution/refresh or conversion parity claim is made. Native Excel pivot-controls XLS reopened without repair after accepting the compatibility warning; PivotTable total 9.5 and PivotChart007 remained, while slicer/timeline controls were lost during legacy conversion. No legacy slicer/timeline parity or runtime claim is made. Native Excel form-controls XLS reopened without repair after the accepted compatibility warning with all 11 raw Obj records and linked marker values retained. litchi-xls exposes 8 typed controls; DropDown/List hit the truncated-subrecord boundary and Button is excluded from the typed form-control set. Label 9 wraps as plain text after legacy conversion. Native formula-owners XLS preserves BIFF8 CSE/shared/data-table/scenario records and caches; native LET renders as =#VALUE! despite stored cache 50 and modern spill behavior is lost after legacy conversion. Native Excel connections XLS retains BIFF8 connection/query records, the legacy query-table projection and DataMashup store. The native Power Query worksheet is omitted by the library after a suppressed parse error; no successful empty result, refresh, CRUD or query-definition parity claim is made. Native Excel date1904-breaks XLS retains DATE1904, BIFF8 date/formula caches, page breaks, print area and two UserBView custom views; the typed workbook exposes date system/custom views but publishes an empty worksheet catalog, so raw Workbook-stream evidence is kept separate from worksheet API parity. The native -1 display is recorded without generalizing a negative-date rule. Native Excel chart-families XLS preserves 18 BIFF8 BOUNDSHEET entries and 17 nested embedded-chart substreams; the generic reader exposes only the SVG marker worksheet, so chart-family package evidence and reader projection remain separate. Native Excel revisions XLS preserves BIFF8 Revision Log/User Names streams, six change markers and final cells; the typed reader exposes final worksheets while collaboration-stream semantics remain raw evidence. Native Excel metadata XLS preserves five BOUNDSHEET8/substreams, BIFF8 rich strings, CellWatch, consolidation and opaque background/header-footer pictures; the typed reader reports only three sheets, so raw five-sheet evidence and the reader boundary remain explicit. Native Excel encrypted XLS preserves BIFF8 FILEPASS CryptoAPI RC4 metadata and reopens with the disposable password; the password-aware reader decrypts in memory and exposes Sheet1 A1:B4.
format_notes.doc: Native Word 97-2004 visual-object DOC reopened without repair after Save As from the DOCX; pictures, rounded rectangle, worksheet and doughnut chart remained visibly present as legacy object/picture representations, while binary semantic parity is unclaimed. Native Word mail-merge main and source DOC variants reopened as CFB/FIB Word 97 files. The main DOC preserves field/source metadata and the source DOC preserves the table/Data stream; after a session-level source relink, the missing-data-source prompt recurred on main-DOC reopen. The cause is unresolved and this does not establish that DOC cannot use the DOCX source. Native Word comments-only protection DOC reopened without repair; the typed DOP projection reports comments_or_read_only=true, form_fields=false, tracked_revisions=false and protection_key=0. Range-level protected bookmarks, passwords and enforcement behavior are not claimed. Native Word legacy-form DOC reopened without repair with three FFData-backed fields, bookmarks, defaults/list entries and DOP form_fields=true. The typed reader reports checkbox/dropdown result states as undefined while retaining defaults; this is stored metadata, not simulated interaction. STATUS_TEXT_010 is absent from saved FFData. Native Word embedded-font DOC retains SttbTtmbd entries and two opaque legacy WordDocument font blocks; the typed reader exposes bounded metadata without treating the blocks as OOXML sfnt payloads. Native Word vector-diagram DOC preserves a CFB OfficeArt group with a blue rectangle, yellow rounded rectangle and textbox, plus native-visible SVG fallback and Basic Process SmartArt; the DOC reader does not establish typed SVG or SmartArt parity and direct CFB marker scans do not expose the SmartArt node labels. Native Word bidi/East Asian DOC preserves the seven marker paragraphs, Word 97 FIB metadata, CHP language IDs and FarEast/complex-script font indexes for Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese and Chinese; the typed reader exposes seven paragraphs and 246 characters, while complete binary language/layout parity remains unclaimed. Native layout-extensions DOC preserves caption fields/table/footnote content and visible symbol/emoji text, but FIB caption pointers 52/53 have lcb=0; w15 layout-extension semantics are not present in this binary derivative. Native Word master/extensionless LEGACY pair preserves PlcfWKB/WKB/FNPI/SttbFnm reference metadata; the reader exposes the path but does not follow the child. Native Word encrypted DOC is a Word 97 CFB with fEncrypted and a version 4.2 CryptoAPI RC4/SHA-1 header; Word reopened it with Office42!, and litchi-doc read the five-paragraph story in memory. Its typed SttbfAssoc write-reservation value is Office42!. No decrypted DOC was written.
format_notes.ppt: Native PowerPoint visual-object, navigation/review, media/OLE and passive-macro 97-2003 CFB/OLE derivatives reopened without repair; visible slides, hidden-slide and notes observations, named custom-show names, record-level links, embedded WAV/Excel metadata, passive VBAInfo/storage and the accepted movie-as-picture warning are recorded, while sections, movie semantic parity, legacy comment/typed navigation parity and strict nested VBA payload decoding remain bounded. Native PowerPoint master-motion PPT reopened without repair after accepting compatibility warnings; seven slides, five MainMaster records, inherited markers, notes, animation/transition records and Zoom fallback images remained visible. Sections, one transition and active Zoom semantics were converted/lost; custom-show names and legacy reader boundaries are recorded. Native modern-media PPT reopened with all eight markers after accepting the picture-conversion warning for video, SVG, 3D and ChartEx; the last three feature slides were confirmed as image fallbacks, while legacy typed picture inventory remains bounded by the BLIP UID mismatch. Native encrypted PPT is a CFB/OLE2 CryptoAPI RC4/SHA-1 128-bit container; native PowerPoint reopened the one-slide marker with OfficeFixture42!, while litchi-ppt accepts the correct password and returns exact PasswordRequired and InvalidPassword boundaries. No decrypted Office file was written.

format_notes.xlsb: Native Excel visual-analytics XLSB reopened without repair with BIFF12 table/filter, PivotTable/PivotCache, sparkline and outline records retained. Indexed worksheet probing passes, while generic source-backed materialization refuses the PivotTable dependency graph and sparkline groups; the boundary is recorded in inspection.json. Native Excel conditional-drawings XLSB reopened without repair; BIFF12 conditional-formatting/DXF records, picture and rounded rectangle are recorded, while worksheet materialization stops at BrtBeginCFRule 0x0023 and stopIfTrue remains false. Native Excel links/objects XLSB reopened after a recovery close with external cached values, B5 picture, classic B6 note and embedded Word preview. Eager/source-backed external-link reads fail on duplicate data-source relationships; raw rich-value parts are present without a typed loader. The first close unexpectedly quit Excel and recovered changes were discarded. Native Excel pivot-controls XLSB reopened without repair with Region/Product slicers, February 2026 timeline, filtered PivotTable total 9.5 and PivotChart007 retained. BIFF12 control records are present; typed slicer/timeline materialization errors remain exact reader boundaries and no refresh, filter-runtime or rendering parity claim is made. Native Excel form-controls XLSB reopened without repair with 11 DrawingML/VML control mirrors and linked values true/2/3/5/10/2/#N/A. litchi-xlsb preserves the raw package/drawing data but exposes no typed form-control API; no ActiveX/VBA payload or macro assignment exists. Native formula-owners XLSB preserves BIFF12 array/shared/data-table/scenario records and dynamic spill caches; the unified reader stops at the native BrtName invalid macro shortcut key 0x00 boundary. Native Excel connections XLSB retains the two BIFF12 external connections, structured query table, raw text-wizard records and DataMashup payload; Workbook::connections passes while the typed Text projection omits files/properties and no public query-tables API is exposed. Refresh, CRUD and runtime behavior remain outside the fixture evidence. Native Excel date1904-breaks XLSB retains the BIFF12 1904 flag, date/formula caches, page-break families, hidden state, print area and two custom-view record groups; typed date-system/value reads pass while page-break/custom-view projections are raw-record evidence. No date formatting or recalculation parity claim is made. Native Excel chart-families XLSB preserves the same 17 XML chart payloads with BIFF12 workbook/worksheet/index and DrawingML parts; XLSX/XLSB chart XML hashes match, while typed chart rendering and chart-sheet semantics remain bounded. Native Excel revisions XLSB preserves BIFF12 revisionHeaders/revisionLog/userNames parts and six deterministic changes; the typed reader exposes final worksheets but not typed revision objects, and no accept/reject/live-collaboration claim is made. Native Excel metadata XLSB records the same watch, ignored-error, note, consolidation and print-picture BIFF12 families; package/record inspection passes, while the high-level xlsb reader timed out and is not claimed. Native Excel encrypted XLSB preserves the Agile CFB/OLE2 envelope and reopens in Excel with the disposable password; litchi-xlsb currently rejects the outer envelope at the OPC ZIP boundary and has no password-aware CFB API.

Passive PPTM/POTM/PPSM VBA storage passed package/source inspection with Disable Macros; execution, compilation, template instantiation, slideshow runtime, encryption and signatures remain unclaimed. Native PowerPoint master-motion PPTX reopened without repair with master/layout markers, Ion theme summary, Fly In timing, Push transition, Morph extension, Summary/Slide/Section Zoom parts, sections/custom shows, hidden slide, notes and modern comment reply. Typed animation/Zoom/source-transition boundaries and no activation/rendering claim remain explicit. Native modern-media PPTX retains a video caption track with language/label metadata, native SVG relationship/payload, model3d GLB/camera/transform/preview parts and native ChartEx waterfall/sunburst parts with embedded editor workbooks; typed caption/model/SVG/waterfall readers retain the exact boundaries recorded in the audit. Native PowerPoint InkML baseline/replay pair preserves p:contentPart ownership, PNG fallback and Replay p:timing; no 2014 InkAction owner is present and typed projections remain bounded. Native encrypted PPTX is a CFB/OLE2 Agile AES-256/SHA-512 envelope with DataSpaces, EncryptionInfo and EncryptedPackage; native PowerPoint reopened the one-slide marker with OfficeFixture42!, while litchi_crypto::ooxml accepts the correct password with authenticated integrity and returns exact wrong/missing password errors. No decrypted Office file was written.

Package relationships, media, chart, OLE and reader projections are recorded; rendering/editability beyond the recorded scope is unclaimed. MERGEFIELD, nested IF, MERGEREC and MERGESEQ placeholders and native Alex/Blair preview values are recorded; execution/refresh is unclaimed. Native Word comments-only protection DOCX reopened without repair; settings.xml stores w:documentProtection edit=comments enforcement=1 with no password attributes, and the native comment/range plus modern comment extension parts are recorded. Enforcement and unlock behavior were not tested. Native Word legacy-form unprotected/protected DOCX fixtures reopened without repair; FORMTEXT, FORMCHECKBOX and FORMDROPDOWN fields, bookmarks, w:ffData defaults/list values and forms-only protection metadata are recorded. STATUS_TEXT_010 appeared in the native field dialog but is absent from saved payloads; HELP_TEXT_010 persists. No modern SDT controls are claimed. Native Word embedded-font full and save-subset DOCX fixtures retain Word font-table/settings metadata, six versus two embedded faces and deobfuscatable payloads; the typed reader leaves Embed::subsetted null and no installation/rendering parity is claimed. Native Word vector-diagram DOCX preserves an imported SVG with Word-normalized SVG plus PNG fallback and alt text, a converted DrawingML/VML vector group, and Basic Process SmartArt with three nodes; litchi-docx exposes the SVG/SmartArt drawings as Other and omits the WPG group from Document::drawing_objects, so package/raw SmartArt inventories remain bounded. Native Word Save As probing exposed DOCX, DOC, DOTX, DOT, RTF, plain text, HTML, filtered HTML, PDF, DOCM, DOTM, Word XML, Word 2003 XML, MHT and ODT, but no Strict DOCX option; this is a bounded native UI route limitation and does not imply library unsupported. Native Word glossary DOCX conversion preserves the four-paragraph main story but removes the glossaryDocument part/relationship and typed glossary catalog; this is conversion-path evidence, not a global AutoText conclusion. Native Word bidi/East Asian DOCX preserves Arabic docDefaults bidi=ar-SA inheritance, direct Hebrew he-IL and Japanese/Chinese eastAsia language properties, script-specific font associations and the exact seven marker paragraphs; no w:bidi, w:rtl or w:kinsoku elements are present, and the typed text projection omits paragraph separators. Native layout-extensions DOCX records w15:collapsed and w15:footnoteColumns=2, cached Figure/Table SEQ fields, one footnote, legacy w:sym and Unicode emoji; the typed paragraph/section facades do not expose the w15 extensions and symEx is absent. Native Word master-document parent/extensionless CHILD packages preserve w:subDoc external closure; the parent reader omits the child story. Native Word encrypted DOCX is an Agile AES-256/SHA-512 CFB/OLE2 envelope; Word reopened it with Office42!, and litchi-crypto/litchi-docx accepted the correct password in memory with authenticated integrity while wrong/missing password outcomes remain exact. No decrypted package was written.

remaining_work: Native authoring is complete within the installed macOS Microsoft Office 16.110.2 scope: 139 final fixtures were closed and reopened in their native Office application without repair, including the Word RTF write-reservation fixture rtf-487. The feature inventory has 252 pending rows after the rtf-487 promotion: 89 operation-unverified, 58 native-UI-limited, 27 externally blocked and 78 native-bounded operation-unverified; no genuine missing authorable family remains. Remaining work is deferred external/profile scope (alternate hosts, certificate/identity/trust and provider/service dependencies) plus library operation semantics such as CRUD, accept/reject, refresh, recalculation, rendering, playback, execution and round-trip behavior. Native evidence does not claim macro execution, compilation, template instantiation, slideshow/media runtime, external refresh, rendering or library projection semantics. There are no pending native fixture candidates; final-coverage-review reconciliation is owned by office_coverage.

scope: Certificate identity/trust, alternate encryption profiles, provider/service dependencies and alternate-host authoring remain conditional probes; do not label them missing from the current native Mac corpus.

Native fixtures establish saved-state evidence; CRUD, accept/reject, refresh, recalculation, rendering, playback, execution and round-trip operation semantics remain separately unverified where the feature inventory says so.

computer_use_notes: Use the real native apps through cua_repl for all Office content creation and Save As. CLI use is limited to repository and fixture metadata, read-only inspection, and validation.
After selecting a Save As format, observe the updated dialog before saving and ensure the filename extension matches the format.
Excel Name Box navigation works by click, select all, paste cell/range address, Return; setValue alone did not move the selection reliably.

PowerPoint Slide Notes accessibility click did not place the caret in the notes pane. A screenshot-grounded click in the visible bottom notes area worked; native Has Notes and notesSlide XML were subsequently verified.
Legacy exports must be verified independently; do not infer full feature equivalence from the originating OOXML document.
Close all fixture documents before final hashing to release temporary Office lock files.
